monitor_changes: 10-second communicate deadline, 2-second child kill/reap wait, no query retry
Phase-at-start/end and monotonic nanosecond timestamps, elapsed seconds, child PID and return codes
Timeout, nonzero exit, spawn/other query error and decode error classification
At most 2048 raw bytes per diagnostic stream; 3000 event-record cap
Exclusive owned monitor_events.jsonl; detailed monitor_failure.json before SIGTERM
RSS/output/wall budget precheck before waiting for GPU query
Shutdown join budget 23 seconds derived from two queries plus one cleanup and scheduling allowance; outer 900-second timeout unchanged
budget_basis: Explicit conservative engineering allowance, not a measured latency quantile. It does not establish the original cause or guarantee the next GPU run will pass. Monitoring remains cooperative; fork/GIL/I/O are not hard-bounded by communicate.
